name: Medicine
blurb: The foundations of medicine as a science and a practice: the biochemistry, microbes, immunity, drugs, genes and nutrients behind health, and the methods clinicians use to examine, test, reason, act ethically and respond in an emergency. Built for pre-med students who want the core mechanisms and numbers right.

sources.t: MedlinePlus Medical Tests, U.S. National Library of Medicine
Vitamin and Mineral Fact Sheets, NIH Office of Dietary Supplements
